content.query:
Select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name = 'CI_Demographics_Retail' and table_schema = 'dw'


TotalRelationshipBalance_Full
TotalRelationshipBalance_Prorated
TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Prorated
TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Prorated
TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Full
TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Prorated
TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Full
TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Prorated
TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Full
TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Prorated
TotalCreditLimitLoans_Full
TotalCreditLimitLoans_Prorated
TotalOutBalPHPCards
TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
TotalCreditLimitCards
TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Full
TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Prorated
TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Full
TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Prorated
TotalFundValueTrust_Full
TotalFundValueTrust_Prorated
TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Full
TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Prorated



SELECT TOP 10
A.CustomerID
,B.CustomerID
,A.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDateFull
,A.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate
,B.TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,B.TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Prorated

,A.AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate
,B.TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,B.TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Prorated

,A.DepositsOutstandingBalance
,B.TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Full
,B.TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Prorated
FROM dw.TotalCustomerHoldings A
LEFT JOIN dw.CI_Demographics_Retail B ON B.CustomerID = A.CustomerID
WHERE B.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
AND (A.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDateFull != B.TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
OR A.AverageDailyBalanceYearToDate != B.TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Prorated
OR A.AverageDailyBalanceMonthToDate != B.TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Prorated
OR A.DepositsOutstandingBalance != B.TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Prorated)





--EXPOSURE
SELECT TOP 10
A.CustomerID
,B.CustomerID
,A.LoansRelationshipExposureFull
,A.LoansRelationshipExposure
,B.TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Full
,B.TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Prorated

,A.LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull
,A.LoansOutstanstandingBalance
,B.TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Full
,B.TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Prorated
FROM dw.TotalCustomerHoldings A
LEFT JOIN dw.CI_Demographics_Retail B ON B.CustomerID = A.CustomerID
WHERE B.CustomerID IS NOT NULL--- AND A.LoansRelationshipExposureFull IS NOT NULL
AND (A.LoansRelationshipExposureFull != B.TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Full
OR A.LoansRelationshipExposure != B.TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Prorated
OR A.LoansOutstanstandingBalanceFull != B.TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Full
OR A.LoansOutstanstandingBalance != B.TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Prorated)


SELECT TOP 10
A.CustomerID
,B.CustomerID
,A.LoansCreditLimitFull
,A.LoansCreditLimit
,B.TotalCreditLimitLoans_Full
,B.TotalCreditLimitLoans_Prorated

,A.CardsRelationshipExposure
,B.TotalOutBalPHPCards
,A.CardsStatementBalance
,B.TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,A.CardsCreditLimit
,B.TotalCreditLimitCards
FROM dw.TotalCustomerHoldings A
LEFT JOIN dw.CI_Demographics_Retail B ON B.CustomerID = A.CustomerID
WHERE B.CustomerID IS NOT NULL ---A.CardsRelationshipExposure IS NOT NULL AND 
AND (A.LoansCreditLimitFull != B.TotalCreditLimitLoans_Full
OR A.LoansCreditLimit != B.TotalCreditLimitLoans_Prorated
OR A.CardsRelationshipExposure != B.TotalOutBalPHPCards
OR A.CardsStatementBalance != B.TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
OR A.CardsCreditLimit != B.TotalCreditLimitCards)


--INVESTMENT
SELECT
A.CustomerID
,B.CustomerID
,A.SecuritiesPortfolio
,B.TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Full
,B.TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Prorated

,A.TreasuryOutstandingInvestmentFull
,A.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment
,B.TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Full
,B.TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Prorated

,A.TrustFundValueFull
,A.TrustFundValue
,B.TotalFundValueTrust_Full
,B.TotalFundValueTrust_Prorated
---SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM dw.TotalCustomerHoldings A
LEFT JOIN dw.CI_Demographics_Retail B ON B.CustomerID = A.CustomerID
WHERE B.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
AND (A.SecuritiesPortfolio != B.TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Prorated
OR A.TreasuryOutstandingInvestmentFull != B.TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Full
OR A.TreasuryOutstandingInvestment != B.TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Prorated
OR A.TrustFundValueFull != B.TotalFundValueTrust_Full
OR A.TrustFundValue != B.TotalFundValueTrust_Prorated)


---TOTALS
SELECT TOP 10
A.CustomerID
,B.CustomerID
,A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull
,A.TotalRelationshipBalance
,B.TotalRelationshipBalance_Full
,B.TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared

,A.TotalRelationshipExposureFull
,A.TotalRelationshipExposure
,B.TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Full
,B.TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Shared
,A.MarketSegment
,A.MarketSegmentFull
,B.MarketSegment
FROM dw.TotalCustomerHoldings A
LEFT JOIN dw.CI_Demographics_Corporate B ON B.CustomerID = A.CustomerID
WHERE B.CustomerID IS NOT NULL
---B.CustomerID IN ('C00000649','C00000727','C00000797','C00000848','C00000768','C00000914','C00000974','C00001184','C00000987','C00001042')
AND (A.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull != B.TotalRelationshipBalance_Full
OR A.TotalRelationshipBalance != B.TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared
OR A.TotalRelationshipExposureFull != B.TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Full
OR A.TotalRelationshipExposure != B.TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Shared)
